title: Read summaries, page deliberately, then select full detail
when: A QA plan catalog, session roster or steering report is large or deployment run history
need: Read summaries and select fields, sections or pages. Default human and JSON replies share a 4,000-byte UTF-8 ceiling; larger results save the complete envelope and streams and return a path with a narrower read recipe. JSON pointers preserve the original success. --full --json explicitly requests complete inline structured data; large human detail stays in saved evidence. Read saved operator instructions before continuing. Deployment lists retain continuation cursors and multi-field get.
surface: CLI help, command results and refusals
recipes: yoke deployment-runs get RUN-ID status current_stage release_lineage
